item.title: S’pore expects all parties to honour commitments, says PM Wong after Indonesia cuts gas exports
item.description: Singapore expects all parties to honour commercial gas contracts, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said after Indonesia announced cuts to its gas exports to Singapore. Singapore's gas importer will take necessary steps to protect its rights and interests. Why it matters: Most of Singapore's electricity is generated with natural gas, and much of that gas comes by pipeline from Indonesia.

item.title: China’s US$3.5 trillion stock rout deepens as profits sink, major stimulus stays elusive
item.description: China's stock market has lost US$3.5 trillion since a May peak, and the CSI 300 is in a bear market. Weak profits, tied to a consumption slump, weigh on earnings, and leaders are in no rush for major stimulus. Why it matters: China is the world's second-largest equities market, so the slide matters for global investors and markets.

Argus – a free, open-source agentic security operations platform – MIT
item.description: Argus is a free, open-source security operations platform that monitors clouds, logins, code and devices. It uses AI agents to investigate and respond to fast attacks, with approvals, dry runs, rollback and a kill switch. Why it matters: Security teams face AI-driven attacks that move faster than people can respond; Argus offers automated defense with human-set guardrails.
